notes: Model routing for Claude runtimes lives in 'tiers'; routing for Codex runtimes / codex-exec cross-dispatch lives in 'codex_tiers' (see references/model-routing-codex.md); Gemini in 'gemini_tiers' (references/model-routing-gemini.md); Grok in 'grok_tiers' (references/model-routing-grok.md). Other runtimes map the abstract tiers onto their own lineup — see 'Portability & Model Routing' in SKILL.md.
limits.max_concurrent_agents caps SIMULTANEOUS dispatches, not the total. A large PR may select 12 agents; launch them in waves of <= max_concurrent_agents and queue the rest.
fallback: null means: on refusal/failure, record the dimension as 'no coverage — degraded' in the report and continue. Never abort the run.

cheap.notes: Triage, patch application, mechanical work. NEVER attach an effort value — Haiku 4.5 rejects the effort parameter.

standard.notes: Most review dimensions. Effort low/medium/high only — never xhigh (costs more than Opus at comparable accuracy; escalate to 'strong' instead). Ships cyber safeguards, so it CAN refuse — same fallback handling as 'deep'.

strong.notes: Coordinator, adjudication, and universal fallback. No meaningful classifier-refusal risk in normal PR review — the safe choice for anything that must not stall.

deep.notes: Risk-surface review only. Safety classifiers can refuse security-adjacent content (elevated false positives on auth/vulns/injection). Mandatory 30-day retention, no ZDR. Expensive.

codex_tiers.notes: Always pass -m and model_reasoning_effort explicitly (never inherit ~/.codex/config.toml defaults). Review leaves run '-s read-only'. Fallbacks stay within the 5.6 and 6.x Astra lineup (astra <-> sol <-> terra); never route to gpt-5.5 or older. Verify IDs against ~/.codex/models_cache.json after any model-generation bump.

cheap.notes: Triage, mechanical checks, patch application. 'medium' for larger shards. Cheapest tier; 'ultra' accepted but may clamp to max.

standard.notes: Most review dimensions; effort up to 'high'. Solid everyday capability at reasonable cost.

strong.notes: Adjudication-grade review and universal fallback; effort up to 'xhigh'. Also the vision tier (attach images with -i) — GPT vision outperforms Claude Opus 4.8 on screenshot/UI review. When quota allows, gpt-6-astra (effort: medium/high) can also serve as strong tier.

deep.notes: Risk-surface review (security, migrations). Flagship model with reasoning levels low..max. Fallback: gpt-5.6-sol (effort: max).

gemini_tiers.notes: Model routing for Gemini runtimes (Gemini CLI, Antigravity). Maps abstract tiers to Gemini 3.8/Flash/Pro lineup.

standard.notes: Most review dimensions (logic, silent failure, style, comment, tests).

deep.notes: Risk-surface review (security, migrations) with maximum reasoning depth.

grok_tiers.notes: Model routing for xAI / Grok runtimes. Maps abstract tiers to Grok 3 lineup.

deep.notes: Risk-surface review (security, migrations) with extended thinking/deep search.
